raimovSystemRole.heading: Developer of RAIM SMILE SYSTEM
raimovSystemRole.body: Atabek Raimov developed RAIM SMILE SYSTEM: a named protocol where smile aesthetics follow bite and function. For the patient this means five steps—diagnostics, design (including a mock-up before irreversible work), team review, a written staged plan with prices, and follow-up with the same clinician. No outcome promise before examination. No franchise or ELITE DENTAL commercial terms. More: https://raimsmile.com/
